subject.title: [Feature Request] Code Verification and Signature for Skills

question: What trust model should OpenClaw enforce for SKILL.md skills before prompt loading and capability use?
rationale: The implementation choice affects security boundaries, trust roots, revocation, unsigned compatibility, ClawHub policy, persisted metadata, and whether existing unsigned skills keep working by default.

options.title: Design canonical signed-skill model
options.body: Specify trusted metadata, signature and digest verification, revocation, unsigned behavior, and runtime capability consequences before queuing implementation.

options.title: Keep verification advisory for now
options.body: Continue improving provenance and audit visibility while deferring runtime enforcement until the broader security model is settled.

options.title: Enforce unsigned restrictions immediately
options.body: Fail closed or restrict unsigned skills now, accepting possible breakage for existing community skills and requiring upgrade messaging.

recommendation.title: Design canonical signed-skill model
recommendation.body: Specify trusted metadata, signature and digest verification, revocation, unsigned behavior, and runtime capability consequences before queuing implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is security/product policy, and steipete is the strongest available decision-routing signal from the issue history.
